content:
❌ Rejected the contribution.
Comment: It's not possible to require players to solve the puzzle using Python and Pandas. They're free to use any other libraries or programming languages available on CodinGame.

I haven't reviewed the puzzle in detail yet. Below are some initial comments:

General
* Please change the contribution's status to WIP to allow reviewers more time to review it.

Formatting / presentation
* Please study the formatting syntax described on this page: https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/statement , and format the variable names, constants and line numbers properly by following the example there.

Constraints
* Please ensure that the test cases cover the range of values permitted by the constraints in a balanced manner.

  For example, since N never exceeds 10 in the current test cases, the upper bound for N should be 10 rather than 1000. Alternatively, please add test cases with a wider variety of N values to cover the full range.

Stub generator
* Please add a write statement, e.g. write answer.

Tags
* Please remove all existing tags. A puzzle can be solved using any programming language supported by the platform, and it does not necessarily require the Pandas library.

  Also, "Beg" isn't a well-formed tag and is redundant in any case, as the puzzle's difficulty level is already set to Easy.

Cases
* Each test case is currently identical to its corresponding validator. Please revise them so that each test-validator pair covers the same scenario but uses slightly different inputs and expects different outputs.

Thanks.
